limits: Native browser-menu contents, physical touch devices and other browser engines were not tested.
Generic Filters, ColumnSettings and sortable-header controls are not configured in these public examples.
Explicit contextMenu copy/pin/unpin and enable/disable behavior were tested in jsdom, separately from default native browser events.

resolvedIssues.test: collection-csv-boundaries.spec.ts / mobile dark / collection selections span pages; page select-all clears only its own rows
resolvedIssues.observed: After returning to page 1, PO-2026-1001 briefly remained selected, then became unchecked without another recorded Playwright action. The first public full run failed.
resolvedIssues.cause: Lazy preview arrival changed which sample .first() referred to. Original Inline edit selection remains checked in the final trace snapshot.

reproductionChecks.scope: Existing full selection test, including Approve and Reject.
Native diagnostic sequence through returning to page 1 and checking the original selection; does not include Approve or Reject.
